speaker: female
text: வணக்கம். இன்று நான் ஆங்கிலம் பேச கொஞ்சம் பயமாக இருக்கிறது. நான் தவறு செய்துவிட்டால் என்ன செய்வது?

speaker: male
text: That is completely okay. Today, we will go slowly. You do not need perfect English. You only need one clear sentence at a time.

speaker: female
text: சரி. அப்படின்னா நான் இன்றைக்கு என்ன கற்றுக்கொள்ளப் போகிறேன்?

speaker: male
text: Today, we will learn how to introduce yourself naturally. Just four simple ideas: your name, where you are from, what you do, and one thing you like.

speaker: female
text: அது easy மாதிரி இருக்கு. First sentence என்ன?

speaker: male
text: Start with this: My name is Meena. Listen once. My name is Meena.

speaker: female
text: நானும் சொல்லலாமா? My name is Meena.

speaker: male
text: Very good. Keep it relaxed. Do not rush. My name is Meena.

speaker: female
text: சரி. அடுத்தது நான் எங்கிருந்து வர்றேன் என்பதா?

speaker: male
text: Exactly. Say: I am from Erode. Or, if you prefer, I come from Erode. The simpler version is: I am from Erode.

speaker: female
text: I am from Erode. இது natural ஆ இருக்கா?

speaker: male
text: Yes. Very natural. Now put the first two together. My name is Meena. I am from Erode.

speaker: female
text: My name is Meena. I am from Erode.

speaker: male
text: Good. Now your work. Say: I work in a bank. Or: I am a teacher. Use whichever sentence matches your life.

speaker: female
text: நான் office ல வேலை பாக்கறேன் என்றால் எப்படி சொல்லலாம்?

speaker: male
text: You can say: I work in an office. Listen to the rhythm. I work in an office.

speaker: female
text: I work in an office.

speaker: male
text: Perfect. Now one personal detail. Say: I like listening to music. Or: I enjoy walking in the evening.

speaker: female
text: எனக்கு music கேட்க ரொம்ப பிடிக்கும். அப்போ I like listening to music. சரியா?

speaker: male
text: Exactly right. Now let us make your full introduction. Listen first. My name is Meena. I am from Erode. I work in an office. I like listening to music.

speaker: female
text: சரி. நான் try பண்ணறேன். My name is Meena. I am from Erode. I work in an office. I like listening to music.

speaker: male
text: That was clear and natural. Notice something important: you did not use difficult words. Good English is not difficult English. Good English is clear English.

speaker: female
text: அது எனக்கு ரொம்ப useful ஆ இருக்கு. நான் usually பெரிய sentence பேசணும்னு நினைத்து பயப்படுவேன்.

speaker: male
text: Then forget long sentences for now. Build confidence with short sentences. One idea. One sentence. Small pause. Then the next idea.

speaker: female
text: சரி. நான் இன்னொரு முறை full introduction சொல்லட்டுமா?

speaker: male
text: Yes. This time, speak a little more slowly. Imagine you are meeting someone friendly for the first time.

speaker: female
text: My name is Meena. I am from Erode. I work in an office. I like listening to music.

speaker: male
text: Excellent. That is enough for today. Before you sleep, repeat these four ideas quietly in your mind: my name, my place, my work, and one thing I like.

speaker: female
text: சரி. நாளைக்கு இதை மறக்காமல் practice பண்ணுறேன்.

speaker: male
text: Good. No pressure. A little English every day is enough. Rest well, and we will continue step by step.
